credits.title: Above & Below
credits.overview: A group of friends' dream diving vacation turns into a fight for survival when brutal criminals attack their boat in open waters.

credits.title: City of Love
credits.overview: Spencer, a troubled rideshare driver in Los Angeles, goes to dangerous lengths to reconnect with the world he lost after spending 20 years in jail.

credits.title: The Eighth Clause
credits.overview: Kat and Borja appear to be a perfect couple, but as in every marriage they keep secrets, lies and infidelities that will come to light the night an unexpected visitor arrives.

credits.title: Ficciones
credits.overview: Alex doesn't have much work to do at his father's video store. But when the likewise film-loving Fátima enters the shop, his boredom is suddenly over.

credits.title: Escape Room
credits.overview: Six strangers find themselves in circumstances beyond their control, and must use their wits to survive.

credits.title: Unbridled
credits.overview: Desperate to keep her husband’s secret, a devoted politician’s wife struggles to stave off threats that could ruin their promising new life.

credits.title: Wild Oats
credits.overview: Everything changes for Eva when she receives an insurance settlement check accidentally made out for $5,000,000 instead of the expected $50,000. She and her best friend take the money and head out for the adventure of a lifetime.

credits.title: Risen
credits.overview: Clavius, a powerful Roman military tribune, and his aide, Lucius, are tasked with solving the mystery of what happened to Jesus in the weeks following the crucifixion, in order to disprove the rumors of a risen Messiah and prevent an uprising in Jerusalem.

credits.title: Ñeñeñe
credits.overview: Mario has prepared something for Cristina, but she doesn't seem very interested in knowing what it is.
